screen: County-held-out fixed two-feature cubic spline plus one M2×M3 interaction on frozen S1 residual; unregistered

method.outcome: Frozen S1 orthogonalized-disagreement residual from pinned provided-feature artifact; never recomputed or fit as a target.
method.basis: For each feature, standardized train-only x, x^2, x^3 and truncated cubic max(x-k,0)^3 terms at distinct internal training-fold quantiles q25/q50/q75; duplicate/boundary knots are omitted. Every resulting basis column is standardized from the training rows only.
method.interaction: Exactly one product of the two train-standardized covariates (M2_z × M3_z); no spline-by-spline interaction grid.
method.validation: Leave one county (FIPS from first five tract GEOID digits) out within each official region; fit intercept plus both fixed additive spline bases and one product interaction on all other supported counties in that region; predict held-out county.
method.baseline: Uncorrected frozen S1 residual, represented by zero residual correction; baseline SSE is sum(residual^2) on identical held-out support.
method.metric: County-held-out delta-R2=(uncorrected baseline SSE - spline correction SSE)/uncorrected baseline SSE; pooled and region-specific results.
method.uncertainty: Paired county-block percentile bootstrap with replacement, sampled within official regions; 2,000 draws with fixed seed.
method.rank_deficiency: OLS uses numpy.linalg.lstsq minimum-norm solution if a fixed spline basis is rank-deficient; no term selection or tuning.
method.support: Intersection of frozen residual and both provided M2/M3 feature-defined masks; no imputation or outcome-dependent exclusions.
method.interpretation_limit: Provided-feature residual association screen only; it does not establish hidden-target accuracy or authorize estimator integration.

county_block_bootstrap.resampling: paired held-county OOF SSEs; sample counties with replacement within each region, retaining region county counts
